seed_data.title: Silk Night Cream
seed_data.description:
50ml 

The Silk Night Cream is a rich, restorative treatment designed to deeply hydrate, firm, and reinforce the skin’s barrier overnight. Enriched with the proprietary Hydrolysed Silk Complex HSC01-A™ , squalene, and vitamin E, the cream delivers intense moisture while supporting elasticity and cell renewal.

Its velvety texture melts into the skin, creating a soft, breathable veil that leaves the complexion visibly firmer and more radiant by morning.

BENEFITS 
Immediately: Skin feels nourished, soothed, and comforted. With continued use: Skin appears firmer, more elastic, and visibly revitalised.

Dermatologically tested and approved. Patch test before application.
Approved under the Leaping Bunny programme.

seed_data.title: Silk Night Serum
seed_data.description:
30ml 

The Silk Night Serum is a concentrated formula developed to support the skin’s overnight regenerative processes. Infused with the proprietary Hydrolysed Silk Complex HSC01-A™ , vitamin A, and hyaluronic acid, this serum helps refine skin texture, improve tone, and visibly reduce the appearance of fine lines.

Its lightweight, fast-absorbing texture delivers immediate hydration and a refined finish, preparing the skin for optimal overnight recovery.

BENEFITS 
Immediately: Skin feels hydrated and soothed. Over time: Skin appears smoother, more even, and visibly renewed by morning.

Dermatologically tested and approved. Patch test before application.
Approved under the Leaping Bunny programme.

seed_data.title: Gentle Silk Cleanser
seed_data.description:
100ml 

The Gentle Silk Cleanser is a daily cleansing formula enriched with the proprietary Hydrolysed Silk Complex HSC01-A™ and glycerin to purify the skin while preserving its essential lipids. Designed to respect the skin’s natural barrier, it removes impurities, environmental residue, and excess oil without disturbing the skin’s optimum hydration equilibrium.

Its lightweight, feather-soft texture transforms on contact with water, emulsifying into a milky fluid that rinses away effortlessly. The result is a complexion that feels clean, comfortable, and prepared for exfoliation.

BENEFITS
Immediately: Skin is refreshed, softened, and hydrated. With continued use: Skin appears smoother, more balanced, and visibly more radiant.

Dermatologically tested and approved. Patch test before application.
Approved under the Leaping Bunny programme.

seed_data.title: Lucamar Baalm 50g  UNSCENTED
seed_data.description:
Uncover the classic power of our Skin Baalm, a refined blend of lanolin and hemp seed oil, designed to care for skin, hands, beards and tattoo's. 

This luxurious balm draws from time-honoured grooming traditions, deeply moisturising and restoring with every use. Lanolin's rich emollient properties work to soften & protect, while the nourishing essence of hemp seed oil helps to rejuvenate and maintain healthy skin. 

Whether soothing dry, cracked hands, taming facial hair, or enhancing the vibrancy of your tattoo, this balm delivers the care your body deserves. 

A timeless companion for the modern man, embracing the strength and elegance of old-world craftsmanship with every application. 

INGREDIENTS: 

Pure Australian Anhydrous Lanolin, Humanely Sourced Vitellaria paradoxa. Organic Shea Butter , Australian Hemp extract. Cera Alba, Australian Bees Wax, Vitamin A, E, Frankincense & Ginger Body Safe fragrance 

No parabéns, petrolatum, Peg's, Mineral oil, sulphates. 

DAILY RITUAL: 

Soften balm between hands and apply on the required areas. Only a little is needed as it goes a long way . 

Proudly Made In South Australia 

Cruelty Free
